description: The first half of a PCA control: read the residual stream at EVERY token of the training prompts after BOS (`{'index': '1:'}`: position 0 is the tokenizer's BOS) — a ragged read, 34 vectors from 4 rows — and the `pca` op reduces it to its top-4 principal directions, an orthonormal (16, 4) basis, saved as a bundle a later document (pca_control.json) loads as a `pca` featurizer. Nothing is trained; the basis is what the data says. (One position per row would be 4 vectors, and four vectors have no rank-4 PCA; the run refuses it before any forward.)
